scope: Remote-sensing provider failures in the default-off signed worker and legacy job runner

behavior.retry_classification: The existing retryability classifier evaluates provider outcomes before any message is normalized.
behavior.persisted_messages: Provider response text is replaced with fixed outcome summaries; caught exceptions retain only their exception class name. Legacy ClickHouse outbox failures retain their type and rollback behavior with a fixed summary.
behavior.provider_logs: GEE and Copernicus adapter errors, plus connection-free ClickHouse projection warnings, log exception class names without exception text.

coverage: legacy attempt, job-status, and returned-result redaction
GEE and Copernicus adapter log/result redaction
connection-free ClickHouse warning redaction in both adapters
legacy ClickHouse outbox error redaction with rollback preserved
existing fallback, tenant scope, scheduling, and automation behavior

limitations: No live GEE/Copernicus parity or credential behavior was tested.
No migration or candidate/legacy database was used.
The feature remains disabled pending credentials, grants, and schedule reconciliation.
